top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Handwashing - Individual Cloth (26 TAC §746.3421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver in the infant classroom did not wash the infant's  hands after diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children are left in buggies longer than fiftteen minutes which is the maximum time frame a child may be in a restrictive device.
